example.title: Return a short MP3 recording
description: Each tab names a file relative to the project root. Java `17` and Maven are required. `mvn spring-boot:run` starts this example after its external requirements are configured.
The project uses Spring Boot 3.5, Java 17+, and `spring-boot-starter-web`.
`ELEVENLABS_API_KEY` and `ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID` come from an ElevenLabs account.
The account must support the requested model and format.
The endpoint belongs behind the application’s authenticated security rules.
Generation uses paid quota and requires an explicit user action.
The command saves the binary response to `speech.mp3`.
A failed response may instead contain an application error.
The command fails on an error status.
explanation: The constructor applies provider authentication and timeout settings to one client.
`toEntity(byte[].class)` receives the binary body and its media type.
The checks reject an empty body or a non-audio response.
Successful responses contain the original audio bytes.
The application limits text to `500` characters for this short recording case.
The limit is an application choice, not a statement of provider limits.
example.commands:
curl --fail-with-body -X POST http://localhost:8080/speech \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"text":"Hello from Spring Boot"}' --output speech.mp3
